# Aurora Robotics Employee Handbook (Version 2, effective March 2024)

## Work Schedule

Aurora Robotics has moved to a remote-first, flexible schedule model. There is no longer a fixed set of core hours company-wide; instead, each team establishes its own collaboration windows based on the needs of its members and customers.

## Remote Work Policy

The 2-day-per-week remote work cap from the previous handbook has been removed. Employees may work fully remotely, fully in-office, or any mix in between, as long as their team's collaboration needs and customer commitments are met. Manager approval is no longer required for remote work arrangements.

## Paid Time Off

Full-time employees now accrue 20 days of paid time off (PTO) per year, up from 15 days under the previous policy. In addition, Aurora Robotics has moved to an unlimited sick leave policy: employees no longer need to draw down PTO balances for illness.

## Parental Leave

Paid parental leave has been increased from 8 weeks to 12 weeks for the birth, adoption, or fostering of a child, reflecting feedback gathered through our 2023 employee engagement survey.

## Health Benefits

Health, dental, and vision insurance coverage continues to begin on an employee's first day of employment, unchanged from the previous handbook version.

## Expense Reports

The expense report submission window has been extended from 30 days to 60 days following feedback that the previous window was too short for employees who travel frequently.

## Dress Code

The formal business casual dress code has been removed. Aurora Robotics now asks employees to "dress for your day" — appropriately for whatever meetings or work they have scheduled.

## Wellness Stipend

This version of the handbook introduces a new quarterly wellness stipend of $150 per employee, which can be used for gym memberships, fitness equipment, or mental health services.
